description: A customer's conversation with a partner, as the partner's sales team works it. Every requirement the customer sends in the conversation joins this one lead.

fields.label: Conversation
fields.description: The customer's chat with the partner. Its CRM Lead is this lead on the partner's CRM.

fields.label: Stage
fields.options:
Open
Qualification
Demo/Making
Proposal/Quotation
Follow Up
Negotiation
Ready to Close
Won
Lost
Junk
Closed
fields.description: Won is set when the customer hires the partner for any of their requirements, and stays. A new requirement opens a Lost, Junk or Closed lead again.

fields.label: Assigned To
fields.description: The partner's team member working this lead. They are added to the conversation and own its Lead on the partner's CRM; with CRM sync on, they need a user on the CRM.

fields.label: Lost Reason
fields.options:
Lost to competitor
No budget
Not responding
Chose another product
Other

fields.label: Assigned in CRM To
fields.description: Set when the Lead was given, on the partner's CRM, to someone who can't take it on Connect: not on the partner's team, or not Owner or Sales. Cleared when the lead is assigned on Connect.
This partner's note on the customer's Lead in Frappe's sales CRM, kept up to date as the lead moves.
fields.label: Frappe CRM Note

name: Partner Lead
